say:1:1910134001:1.text: Tolan, that was amazing! Your wooden fish is really sturdy!
say:1:1910134001:1.source_cn: 图澜，你刚才那一下好厉害呀，你的木头鱼很结实！

say:2:1910134002:1.text: Hey! How many times I gotta tell you, it's NOT a wooden fish! It's the Waterstrider!
say:2:1910134002:1.source_cn: 喂，都说了这不是木头鱼，是水行器！

say:3:1910134003:1.text: Okay, okay, I know... Yikes, you hit your head! Are you okay?
say:3:1910134003:1.source_cn: 好好，我知道啦……哎呀，你的头撞伤了！疼吗？

say:4:1910134004:1.text: Tch. It's just a scratch. Quit fussing over me.
say:4:1910134004:1.source_cn: 啧，这点小伤算什么，别管咱。

say:5:1910134005:1.text: And who's this supposed to be?
say:5:1910134005:1.male: And who's this supposed to be?
say:5:1910134005:1.female: And who's this supposed to be?

say:6:1910134006:0.text: Oh! This is my new friend, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! He saved me when I was on the surface—
say:6:1910134006:0.source_cn: 哦，忘记和你介绍了！这是我带回来的新朋友，<style...
say:6:1910134006:0.male: Oh! This is my new friend, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! He saved me when I was on the surface—
say:6:1910134006:0.female: Oh! This is my new friend, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! She saved me when I was on the surface—

say:7:1910134007:0.text: Speaking of, I found that "old man" you told me about!
say:7:1910134007:0.source_cn: 对了，说到这个，我在岸上找到那个叫“老头子”的人了。

say:9:1910134009:1.text: Save it. I don't wanna hear it. I bet it was nothing good anyway!
say:9:1910134009:1.source_cn: 算了，别跟咱说了，反正肯定不是什么好话！

say:10:1910134010:0.text: Don't be like that! Sure, he's grumpy and speaks real mean... but I could tell he was super worried about you.
say:10:1910134010:0.source_cn: 别这么说呀。虽然他凶巴巴的，说话也不好听……但我能看出...

say:11:1910134011:1.text: The only reason they found me stuck under that boat was because they were heading out to sea to look for you! When I told him you were safe here, he looked so relieved.
say:11:1910134011:1.source_cn: 他们之所以能找到卡在船下的我，就是因为想出海来找你。我...

say:12:1910134012:1.text: What?! You told me I'm here?!
say:12:1910134012:1.source_cn: ——哈？你把咱在这里的事也告诉他了？！

say:13:1910134013:1.text: ... Oops. Sorry! Please don't be mad!

say:14:1910134014:1.text: But if they went out looking for you and got hurt, you'd be worried too, wouldn't you?
say:14:1910134014:1.source_cn: 要是他们真的出海找你，遇到了危险，你也会很着急的吧？

say:15:1910134015:1.text: No matter where our adventures take us, our families are always important to us. We all have to go home eventually.
say:15:1910134015:1.source_cn: 毕竟，无论去哪里冒险，家人都是彼此最重要的存在呀。总有...

say:16:1910134016:1.text: Keep your nose out of my business! And don't think you can talk me into going back! I'm not going back, and that's that!
say:16:1910134016:1.source_cn: 不懂就不要多管闲事，也别想劝咱！咱说了不回去就是不回去！

choice_prompt:17:1910134016.text: Keep your nose out of my business! And don't think you can talk me into going back! I'm not going back, and that's that!
choice_prompt:17:1910134016.source_cn: 不懂就不要多管闲事，也别想劝咱！咱说了不回去就是不回去！

say:18:1910134017:1.text: Who're you calling a kid?! I'm sixteen! Just because you're taller than me doesn't make you better!
say:18:1910134017:1.source_cn: 谁是小朋友？！咱已经十六岁了，别以为你长得高就了不起！

say:19:1910134020:1.text: Elphira, forget about that old man. I need a wooden cog. The steering's acting up again.
say:19:1910134020:1.source_cn: 艾菲拉，别管老头子的事。咱需要木栓，水行器的转向有问题。

say:20:1910134021:1.text: There's no wood in Coralia... Would seaweed work? I can go get some!
say:20:1910134021:1.source_cn: 塔拉萨没有木头，海藻能用吗？我去拿给你。

say:21:1910134022:1.source_cn: 那种黏糊糊的东西——没用。

choice_prompt:22:1910134022.source_cn: 那种黏糊糊的东西——没用。

say:24:1910134024:1.text: Those materials aren't like wood; they don't bend or give. Put too much force on them when turning, and they'll wear the cog right out.
say:24:1910134024:1.source_cn: 那些材料不像木头，它们没有韧性。拿它们替代，转向时一用...

say:25:1910134025:1.text: Then I'd have a much bigger problem on my hands than just replacing a cog.
say:25:1910134025:1.source_cn: 到时候，就不只是换木栓的事了。

say:26:1910134026:1.text: 你仔细打量着眼前的这台“水行器”。尽管材料有些原始，手工痕迹明显，但设计的确称得上精妙。
say:26:1910134026:1.source_cn: 你仔细打量着眼前的这台“水行器”。尽管材料有些原始，手...

say:27:1910134027:1.text: The low front end parts the water and reduces resistance. At the rear, two steering fins, one above the other, help with turning and keep the pressure on the wooden cog manageable.
say:27:1910134027:1.source_cn: 前段较低，能将水流分开，减少压力；尾部的舵鳍则分成上下...

say:28:1910134028:1.text: If he wrapped a layer of fish bone around a coral or bone cog and coated it with lubricant grease, it would solve the friction issue easily.
say:28:1910134028:1.source_cn: 只要在珊瑚或鱼骨做的栓子上缠一层鱼筋，再涂上润滑的脂膏...

choice_prompt:29:1910134028.text: If he wrapped a layer of fish bone around a coral or bone cog and coated it with lubricant grease, it would solve the friction issue easily.
choice_prompt:29:1910134028.source_cn: 只要在珊瑚或鱼骨做的栓子上缠一层鱼筋，再涂上润滑的脂膏，就能解决图澜口中说的问题。

say:30:1910134029:1.text: Wow! You really know your stuff! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, can you build a Waterstrider too? Can all surface dwellers make wooden fish like this?
say:30:1910134029:1.male: Wow! You really know your stuff! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, can you build a Waterstrider too? Can all surface dwellers make wooden fish like this?
say:30:1910134029:1.female: Wow! You really know your stuff! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, can you build a Waterstrider too? Can all surface dwellers make wooden fish like this?

say:31:1910134030:1.text: No way! I'm the only one in Kaflan who can build this.
say:31:1910134030:1.source_cn: 才不是，卡什澜只有咱会做。

say:32:1910134031:1.text: But... hey, you. <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Didn't expect you to know a thing or two.
say:32:1910134031:1.male: But... hey, you. <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Didn't expect you to know a thing or two.
say:32:1910134031:1.female: But... hey, you. <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Didn't expect you to know a thing or two.

choice_prompt:33:1910134031.text: But... hey, you. <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Didn't expect you to know a thing or two.
choice_prompt:33:1910134031.source_cn: 不过……喂，大个子，你叫<style=stress><player_name></style>？看不出来，你这家伙还蛮懂的嘛。
choice_prompt:33:1910134031.male: But... hey, you. <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Didn't expect you to know a thing or two.
choice_prompt:33:1910134031.female: But... hey, you. <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Didn't expect you to know a thing or two.

say:35:1910134034:1.text: I'm not sticking around here long anyway. As soon as this ride's fixed, I'm outta here. I'm putting as much ocean between me and Kaflan as I can.
say:35:1910134034:1.source_cn: 咱不会在这里待很久，等水行器修好，咱就立刻出发离开这片...

say:36:1910134035:1.text: So don't go acting all buddy-buddy with me!
say:36:1910134035:1.source_cn: 所以，没必要跟咱套近乎！

say:37:1910134036:1.text: *Giggle* He says that, but I bet he's secretly happy to have someone talk engineering with!
say:37:1910134036:1.source_cn: 哼哼，虽然嘴上这么说，但其实找到能一起谈论水行器的朋友...

say:38:1910134037:1.text: You can't hide anything from me. I'm a master at reading people's feelings!
say:38:1910134037:1.source_cn: 我对情绪的感知可是很敏锐的，别想瞒过我哦。

say:39:1910134038:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, here's a secret. Tolan acts tough with his Waterstrider too, but he actually treasures it.
say:39:1910134038:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, here's a secret. Tolan acts tough with his Waterstrider too, but he actually treasures it.
say:39:1910134038:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, here's a secret. Tolan acts tough with his Waterstrider too, but he actually treasures it.

say:40:1910134039:0.text: He built it himself, and it moves so fast even swordfish can't catch it! It breaks down a lot, but he works super hard to fix it every time. He and his "old man" are pretty alike in that way!
say:40:1910134039:0.source_cn: 因为，那架水行器是图澜自己做的，冲刺起来的速度连剑鱼都...
say:40:1910134039:0.male: He built it himself, and it moves so fast even swordfish can't catch it! It breaks down a lot, but he works super hard to fix it every time. He and his "old man" are pretty alike in that way!
say:40:1910134039:0.female: He built it himself, and it moves so fast even swordfish can't catch it! It breaks down a lot, but he works super hard to fix it every time. He and his "old man" are pretty alike in that way!

choice_prompt:41:1910134039.text: He built it himself, and it moves so fast even swordfish can't catch it! It breaks down a lot, but he works super hard to fix it every time. He and his "old man" are pretty alike in that way!
choice_prompt:41:1910134039.source_cn: 因为，那架水行器是图澜自己做的，冲刺起来的速度连剑鱼都赶不上！虽然很容易出故障，但他一直在很努力地修理。这点图澜和他的老头子有点像呢。
choice_prompt:41:1910134039.male: He built it himself, and it moves so fast even swordfish can't catch it! It breaks down a lot, but he works super hard to fix it every time. He and his "old man" are pretty alike in that way!
choice_prompt:41:1910134039.female: He built it himself, and it moves so fast even swordfish can't catch it! It breaks down a lot, but he works super hard to fix it every time. He and his "old man" are pretty alike in that way!

say:42:1910134040:1.text: Huh? What's that? Is that some kind of stage surface dwellers go through?
say:42:1910134040:1.source_cn: 青春期？那是什么，是陆地人的幼年形态吗？
say:42:1910134040:1.male: Huh? What's that? Is that some kind of stage surface dwellers go through?
say:42:1910134040:1.female: Huh? What's that? Is that some kind of stage surface dwellers go through?

say:44:1910134043:1.text: Besides, it's not broken! I just got one part of the modification wrong, so the steering stopped working. Once I get the right parts, I'll have it fixed in a flash!
say:44:1910134043:1.source_cn: 还有，这不是故障，只是改造方向出了点问题，转向失灵而已...

say:45:1910134044:0.text: And I'm not stopping there! I'm going to gather more materials and rebuild the whole thing from scratch! Make it faster than anything else in the sea!
say:45:1910134044:0.source_cn: 不仅要修好，咱还要再收集其他材料，从头到尾改装一遍！让...

choice_prompt:46:1910134044.text: And I'm not stopping there! I'm going to gather more materials and rebuild the whole thing from scratch! Make it faster than anything else in the sea!
choice_prompt:46:1910134044.source_cn: 不仅要修好，咱还要再收集其他材料，从头到尾改装一遍！让它跑得比任何海里游的东西都快！

narration:47:1910134045:0.text: Just then, a loud, piercing conch horn echoes across the city.
narration:47:1910134045:0.source_cn: 就在这时，城中传来一阵高亢的螺号声

say:49:1910134046:0.text: 你回头望去，只见艾菲拉的家人纷纷走出螺屋。上至祖母摩淖亚，下至最小的幼童……海裔们倾巢而出。
say:49:1910134046:0.source_cn: 你回头望去，只见艾菲拉的家人纷纷走出螺屋。上至祖母摩淖...

say:52:1910134048:0.text: 到<style="highlight">围猎采集</style>的时候啦，我也该走啦。你们先回房间休息吧，等围猎结束，我再来找你们玩！

choice:46:0:1.text: Maybe focus on fixing it before you try rebuilding it...
choice:46:0:1.source_cn: 你还是先把它修好再改装吧……
choice:46:0:1.male: Maybe focus on fixing it before you try rebuilding it...
choice:46:0:1.female: Maybe focus on fixing it before you try rebuilding it...

choice:41:0:1.text: Ah, he's going through puberty. I get it.
choice:41:0:1.male: Ah, he's going through puberty. I get it.
choice:41:0:1.female: Ah, he's going through puberty. I get it.

say:55:1910134042:1.text: Hey! Don't think complimenting my ride means I won't lose my temper with you!
say:55:1910134042:1.source_cn: 喂，别以为夸咱的水行器几句，咱就不跟你急！

choice:41:1:2.text: Cool ride, but your manners could use an upgrade.
choice:41:1:2.source_cn: 水行器不错，但他也该学学礼貌用语
choice:41:1:2.male: Cool ride, but your manners could use an upgrade.
choice:41:1:2.female: Cool ride, but your manners could use an upgrade.

choice:33:0:1.text: What, that mean we're friends now?
choice:33:0:1.source_cn: 怎么样，是不是愿意跟咱交朋友了？
choice:33:0:1.male: What, that mean we're friends now?
choice:33:0:1.female: What, that mean we're friends now?

choice:33:1:2.text: I can help you fix it.
choice:33:1:2.male: I can help you fix it.
choice:33:1:2.female: I can help you fix it.

choice:22:0:1.text: Could you use a sturdy piece of coral instead?
choice:22:0:1.source_cn: 或许可以用坚硬的珊瑚枝替代？
choice:22:0:1.male: Could you use a sturdy piece of coral instead?
choice:22:0:1.female: Could you use a sturdy piece of coral instead?

choice:22:1:2.source_cn: 你可以试试用鱼骨替代

say:57:1910134018:1.text: What's it to you? Did the old man send you here to drag you back or something?!
say:57:1910134018:1.source_cn: 那又咋样。你是老头子喊来带咱回去的？

choice:17:1:2.text: Sounds like things are rough in your family.
choice:17:1:2.source_cn: 看来你和家里人关系不太好
choice:17:1:2.male: Sounds like things are rough in your family.
choice:17:1:2.female: Sounds like things are rough in your family.

say:58:1910134019:1.text: Hmph! They can't wait to be rid of me, I know it.
say:58:1910134019:1.source_cn: 哼，他们巴不得咱走呢，咱清楚得很。

choice:17:2:3.text: Your family's worried sick about you.
choice:17:2:3.source_cn: 你离家出走，家里人很担心你
choice:17:2:3.male: Your family's worried sick about you.
choice:17:2:3.female: Your family's worried sick about you.
